title: Center-preserving descent data and actions on finite normalized blowup towers
statement:
Let $n\geq0$ and let $T=(T_i,J_i,b_i)_{0\leq i\leq n}$ be a finite normalized blowup tower with its coherent ideal centers [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization], using the componentwise-normalized construction [def-trf-normalized-blowup]. Put $t_0=\mathrm{id}_{T_0}$ and $t_{i+1}=t_i\circ b_i:T_{i+1}\to T_0$. Say its centers are nowhere dense when each $V(J_i)\subset T_i$ is nowhere dense. A center-preserving map $c:T\to S$ between length-$n$ towers is a family $c_i:T_i\to S_i$ commuting with all adjacent arrows and satisfying $J_i=K_i\mathcal O_{T_i}$, the extension along $c_i$. A center-preserving isomorphism is such a family of scheme isomorphisms. Such a map is cartesian when the square with horizontal arrows $c_i,c_0$ and vertical arrows $t_i,s_i$ is a fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] for every $i$.

Given $u:T_0\to X$ of schemes [def-pc-scheme], a center-preserving descent datum $D$ consists of a scheme descent datum [def-pd-descent-datum] on each $T_i\to T_0$ relative to $u$, commuting with every $b_i$. On the universal overlap $T_i\times_X T_0$, let $p_i$ be the first projection and let $q_i$ be the map to $T_i$ obtained by the datum transport from the first lift to the second. Require $p_i^*J_i=q_i^*J_i$ as ideal sheaves for $i<n$. Equivalently the overlap isomorphisms identify the actual center ideals. The existing scheme descent data include naturality, the diagonal identity and the triple-overlap cocycle. Two $W$-points of $T_i$ are $D$-related if one is the transport of the other along two $W$-lifts to $T_0$ with equal composite to $X$. A tower $S$, an isomorphism $e:S_0\simeq X$ and a center-preserving map $c:T\to S$ realize $D$ when $e c_0=u$, all level squares are cartesian, and $c_i$ identifies every pair of $D$-related points. Define the center image subset of $T_0$ to be $\bigcup_{i<n}t_i(V(J_i))$.

For a presheaf $G$ of groups on schemes, an action on $T$ means, naturally in every test scheme $W$, actions of $G(W)$ on $\operatorname{Hom}(W,T_i)$, satisfying the group identity and multiplication laws, commuting with $b_i$, and preserving pulled-back center ideals: $(g x)^*J_i=x^*J_i$. This includes constant abstract groups and representable scheme-valued groups. An action is compatible with $D$ when applying the same $g\in G(W)$ to any two $D$-related $W$-points gives $D$-related points. No triviality of the base action is imposed.
